purpose: Evidence packet only. Pegasus distinguishes domestic/North Cyprus hold carriage from international flights. TUI's cited cabin exclusion is only for routes to or from the UK. Volotea explicitly excludes passenger hold, not merely the present itinerary.

provenance_defaults.reviewer: Codex — lecture directe de la page officielle

facts.condition_scope: the 8 kg ceiling applies to animal plus cage; destination restrictions, cage requirements and pet reservation apply
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable. Do not clear a lighter dog without the combined cage weight and route conditions.
facts.quote: Pets weighing over 8 kg in their cages must be placed in the cargo hold.
facts.locator: Frequently Asked Questions → What are the rules for travelling with pets?

facts.condition_scope: the rule is limited to Pegasus domestic scheduled and North Cyprus flights; carrier requirements and booking conditions apply
facts.finder_effect: For an eligible domestic/North Cyprus route, passenger hold can be proposed conditionally above 8 kg combined. It must not appear for international routes.
facts.quote: Si le poids total de l'animal avec la cage dépasse 8 kg, l'animal (AVIH) est transporté dans le conteneur de fret climatisé.

facts.condition_scope: the published AVIH rule is expressly limited to domestic and North Cyprus flights
facts.finder_effect: Do not offer Pegasus passenger hold for an international itinerary under this evidence.
facts.quote: il n'est pas possible de transporter des animaux de compagnie non transportés en cabine (AVIH) sur les vols internationaux.

facts.condition_scope: the official statement is restricted to TUI flights to or from the United Kingdom; service and route constraints remain for all other cases
facts.finder_effect: Do not offer an ordinary pet dog in the passenger cabin on a TUI itinerary to or from the UK.
facts.quote: All pets flying with TUI, travel in the hold as cargo and not in the passenger cabin to or from the UK.
facts.locator: Can I take my pet with me? → How your pet will travel

facts.condition_scope: the pet must be cleared by TUI Cargo for the particular flight; country restrictions, documents and crate conditions apply
facts.finder_effect: For a TUI route to or from the UK, give a conditional cargo lead rather than a promise of a booked place.
facts.quote: Your pet can usually go on the same flight as you.
facts.locator: Can I take my pet with me? → How your pet will travel

facts.condition_scope: the 10 kg ceiling includes non-rigid box, pet and accessories; UK, Ireland and Malta routes are excluded
facts.finder_effect: For a 30 or 32 kg dog, cabin is not suitable. Under 10 kg dog body weight alone remains insufficient without carrier and route checks.
facts.quote: Maximum weight of the box (including the pet and its accessories) is 10 Kg.

facts.condition_scope: the statement expressly concerns pet transport in the aircraft hold and is not a conclusion drawn from cabin limits
facts.finder_effect: Do not offer Volotea passenger hold for an ordinary pet dog.
facts.quote: Volotea does not offer the option of transporting pets in the aircraft hold.

intentionally_unset.reason: The direct sources establish the passenger AVIH rules but not a general ordinary pet-dog cargo service.
The TUI source uses the term 'hold as cargo'; this packet records the UK cargo process and does not force it into the repository's passenger-hold category.
Volotea's Conditions of Carriage say it does not transport cargo, but this cohort does not treat that general statement as a fully specified pet-cargo policy.

Official conditions were located that refuse live animals except recognised assistance dogs, but their publication dating requires a fresh current-document check before importing a categorical ordinary-pet rule.
